links.plain: working-memory scratchpad keeping interrupted goals pinned online
links.function: actively sustains uncompleted task plans in foreground working awareness until closure occurs
links.narration_bridge: Sustains the 1.9x unfinished-task accessibility observed in Zeigarnik (1927) and reviewed by MacLeod (2020, SRC6).

links.plain: conflict alarm pinging unresolved obligations at night
links.function: flags the gap between an accepted commitment and an interrupted unfinished state
links.narration_bridge: Drives recurring intrusive reminders while a task remains unscheduled (SRC3, SRC6).

links.plain: frontal planner powering down once payment or a written tomorrow plan locks in
links.function: releases active goal-monitoring tension the instant a bill is paid or a concrete next-day slot is logged
links.narration_bridge: Explains both the Berlin waiter's 30-second post-payment wipe (SRC1) and end-of-day written closure (SRC3).

links.plain: memory hub tagging where and when to resume tomorrow morning
links.function: binds the written next-morning desk cue to the deferred action so frontal loops can rest overnight
links.narration_bridge: Links contextual cues to deferred retrieval in MacLeod (2020, SRC6).
